definition: JOONE (Java Object Oriented Neural Engine) is a component based neural network framework built in Java.
details: JOONE (Java Object Oriented Neural Engine) is a component based neural network framework built in Java.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is JOONE.
